subject: Security re-attest & renewal: phased evidence handoff, one-time credit, and capacity uplift
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@blueharbor.com>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@blueharbor.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 re-attest + capacity: timeline and options

Hi Mateo,

We're kicking off BlueHarbor's renewal conversations for our enterprise plan (term expires 2026-09-30) and SOC 2 re-attestation is top of the list. Auditor (AuditOps) expects evidence for the period Jul 2025–Jun 2026, including access logs, key rotation records, and sample incident response traces.

Two asks up front:
- Can Redwood accept a phased evidence handoff (we can't pull everything at once due to internal bandwidth)? We prefer a 3-week rolling upload window.
- We anticipate a usage bump (GPU-heavy models) starting Aug — can we get options for a short-term dedicated capacity uplift for Q3 plus pricing for a permanent seat increase?

Please include any runbooks or templates you need from our side. Also flag if you require any new attestations beyond the SOC 2 scope (e.g., change to retention windows).

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of InfoSec, BlueHarbor Financial
elena.ruiz@blueharbor.com
+1 415-555-0193

On Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:15:22 -0700 AuditOps <auditops@external-audit.com> wrote:
> Hi Elena / BlueHarbor team,
>
> Quick note: a phased handoff is acceptable if samples are time-stamped and we receive a manifest mapping evidence files to control IDs. We'll coordinate with your engineering lead.
>
> — AuditOps
From: mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@blueharbor.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, AuditOps <auditops@external-audit.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attest + capacity: timeline and options

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We're aligned on a phased handoff and can support a 3-week rolling evidence window. High-level proposal below:

1) Evidence cadence
- Week 1 (kickoff): manifest + highest-priority artifacts (access logs, key rotation ledger).
- Week 2: incident response samples + config snapshots.
- Week 3: supplementary samples and auditor queries.

We'll provide a manifest template (attached: evidence_manifest_v1.xlsx) and a mapping to SOC control IDs. AuditOps, we'll leave the sample format to you but will deliver time-stamped logs in CSV/JSON.

2) Capacity uplift options
- Short-term dedicated uplift (Q3 Aug–Sep): add 4x reserved GPU seats for the quarter. Pricing: usage-based surcharge + $12k flat uplift for the reserved window.
- Permanent seat increase: 8 additional seats, annual commit, negotiated discount tier.

3) One-time renewal credit
- To offset the operational load of the phased handoff we're prepared to offer a one-time credit of $8,000 against Q3 invoices if BlueHarbor signs the renewal amendment by Jul 20.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm the 3-week window and the target evidence cutoff (we recommend Jun 30, 2026).
- Karthik, can you review pricing/credit and confirm approval path?
- Lauren, I'll need the amendment draft and terms for a seat-onramp.

Attachments: evidence_manifest_v1.xlsx, log-retention-matrix.pdf

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 650-555-0147

--
Mateo Alvarez
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@blueharbor.com>, procure@blueharbor.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attest + capacity: timeline and options

Looping in finance & legal thoughts (internal note first):

- The $8k one-time credit is approvable for renewals <= $250k ARR and where the renewal is signed before Jul 20. BlueHarbor is within that band, so ok from finance.
- For the short-term uplift pricing: the $12k flat for Aug–Sep + normal usage is acceptable but we should offer a pro-rated option for partial-month start dates.
- Permanent seat increase discount: offer 10% off list for commits >= 12 months; include a 30-day exit clause during the first 60 days to ease procurement.

Lauren: please prepare a clean amendment (redwood_capacity_amendment_draft.docx) with the three options (no uplift, temporary uplift, permanent seat increase + discount) and the credit clause. I'll sign off after legal+finance review.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Operations
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

> On Wed, Jul 1, 2026 at 09:32 AM mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai wrote:
> > We'll provide a manifest template (attached) and a mapping to SOC control IDs.
From: mateo_alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@blueharbor.com>, procure@blueharbor.com
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, AuditOps <auditops@external-audit.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Jul 2026 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attest + capacity: timeline and options — confirmed plan

Elena — thanks for the quick responses this week. Summarizing agreed path so we have a single source of truth: 

Agreed items
- Evidence window: phased 3-week handoff starting Mon Jul 12 (targeting Jun 30 cutoff). AuditOps to receive manifest + Week1 artifacts by Jul 14.
- Capacity: temporary dedicated uplift (4 GPU seats) for Aug 1–Sep 30 at $12k + prorated usage; option to convert to 8-seat permanent add-on at 10% discount for a 12-month commit.
- One-time credit: $8,000 applied to Q3 invoice if amendment signed by Jul 20.
- Legal: amendment draft (attached) includes pro-rate language and 30-day trial exit for permanent seat add-on.

Action items
- BlueHarbor (Elena / procurement): confirm Jul 12 start and share internal engineering contact for log extraction.
- AuditOps: confirm sample schemas for logs (CSV/JSON) and where they'd like manifests delivered (S3 share / secured Drive).
- Redwood (Lauren/Karthik/Mateo): make final edits to amendment and circulate DocuSign link by Jul 08.

Attachments: redwood_capacity_amendment_draft.docx (internal draft), evidence_manifest_v1.xlsx, log-retention-matrix.pdf

I'll put a calendar hold for Jul 12–Aug 02 for the evidence sprint. If anything needs to change, reply-all so we keep traceability.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this over the line.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+1 650-555-0147

--
Mateo Alvarez
Redwood Inference
